subject: 110 dogs just hit 15% weight loss
preview_text: Your pup could be next, but only if you start today. See what they did.
body_paragraphs: This morning, I checked the PupShape dashboard and saw something that made me smile — 110 dogs have already lost an average of 15% of their body weight in just 8 weeks. That’s not a statistic. That’s 110 dogs who can now chase a ball without wheezing, jump on the couch again, and get belly rubs without their owners feeling guilty.

But here’s the thing: while those dogs are shedding pounds and gaining years, your pup is still waiting. Every day you delay is a day they stay heavier, and every extra pound adds pressure on their joints, heart, and energy. The owners of those 110 dogs didn’t have a secret — they just opened the app, followed the meal plan, and tracked progress. No guesswork, no confusing vet advice.

The feature that made the biggest difference for them? The custom meal plan that calculates exactly how many calories your dog needs based on breed, age, and weight. You set it up once, and it tells you what to feed them and how many treats are okay. No more second-guessing. No more guilt.

Open PupShape now and check your dog’s progress. If you haven’t set up the meal plan yet, do it in 2 minutes. Your dog’s next milestone is waiting. P.S. The first 10 owners who update their dog’s weight today get a free treat guide — just tap 'log weight' in the app.
